P1B-MCMC.note: P1B's MCMC companion manuscript. Not one of the six campaign papers, but its PDF is mirrored under served roots, so it needs a canonical owner or its mirrors read as orphans.

served_pdf_policy.description: Reverse-direction directive-G data. Directive G pushes each paper OUT to its known mirrors; this block lets tools/verify_pdf_mirror_integrity.py walk the served tree back IN and prove every served PDF, and every site reference to one, is accounted for.
